The `SSLHandshakeException` (`CertPathValidatorException: Trust anchor for certification path not found`) occurred because Android (API 24+) by default trusts only system CA certificates. The debug environment connects to a local server at `https://10.0.2.2:8443/` using the self-signed certificate in [shelftap-dev-ca.pem](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r4/work/dev-ca/shelftap-dev-ca.pem), which was not configured as a trusted anchor in the app.

### Changes Made

1. **Copied CA certificate**:
   - Added [shelftap_dev_ca.pem](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r4/work/app/src/main/res/raw/shelftap_dev_ca.pem) into raw resources so it can be resolved by Android's resource system.

2. **Added Network Security Configuration**:
   - Created [network_security_config.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r4/work/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml) using `<debug-overrides>` to trust `@raw/shelftap_dev_ca` during debug builds without compromising release builds.

3. **Updated Android Manifest**:
   - Added `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` to the `<application>` tag in [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r4/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L9).
